problem:
At a geologic study site, a sample is found with $42%$ of its original cesium-135 content. Given that the half-life of cesium-135 is $2.3$ million years, how old is the sample? Round your answer to **one decimal place**.

The sample is approximately
{{field-1}}
million years old.
